definitions.explanation: A salad of finely shredded raw cabbage, usually with carrot, dressed with mayonnaise or a vinegar dressing.

examples.japanese: コールスローを{少|すこ}し{食|た}べた。
ハンバーガーにコールスローが{付|つ}いてきた。
{残|のこ}ったキャベツでコールスローを{作|つく}るとちょうどいい。
examples.english: Making coleslaw with leftover cabbage works out just right.

notes:
Borrowed from English "coleslaw." A shredded cabbage salad, commonly served as a side with fried food.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コールスローを{作|つく}る: to make coleslaw
- コールスローを{添|そ}える: to serve coleslaw as a side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- グリーンサラダ: green salad — leafy salad rather than shredded cabbage
- {千切|せんぎ}りキャベツ: shredded cabbage — plain shredded cabbage served undressed, e.g. beside a cutlet
